description.summary: With this song, one can amplify the underlying music of the spheres in the song’s area of effect to infuse yourself and all creatures within 20 feet of you, friend and foe alike.
description.value: With this song, one can amplify the underlying music of the spheres in the song’s area of effect to infuse yourself and all creatures within 20 feet of you, friend and foe alike. All creatures that begin their turn within the area of this song’s effect gain fast healing 5, resistance 10 to all elemental types, and a +3 sacred bonus on all saving throws against poison and disease. Any creature that enters the area of effect does not gain the benefits of the music of the spheres until it begins its turn in that area.
